findings.claim: GetPropertyIdentifierLocation still indexes DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] unconditionally. The AD0001 crash is not fully fixed.

receipt_plan.detail: Run Receipts.GeneratedTests.MetadataGenericStructDiagnosticsReceipts.KeylessPropertyOnMetadataGenericStructDoesNotCrashGeneratorOrAnalyzers. On head, MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer reaches GetPropertyIdentifierLocation with no declaring syntax and the test fails with AD0001/IndexOutOfRangeException.
